summary: Built in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1: W-001 on a local drive letter now requires outcome completed and the coverage panel and records the coverage figures, writes docs/proof-runs/w001-<letter>-drive.json as soon as the finished run is judged, and with -Stopped compares a run stopped partway against it (six classes). New cases W-002 (online-only before and after a scan) and W-003 (Stop-to-ending timing on a share), both kept out of -Case All. The record guard moved to docs/proof-runs, with the SL-107 rule entry deleted, plant rows S91-S95/P41-P42 added, five scripts retired, and the oracle given a refused-another-code class. Run for real: the full suite passed 1249/1249, the rules harness passed 31/31 affected rows, and W-001 -Stopped on a SUBST drive held end to end. The W-002 and W-003 rig runs and the maintainer's C:\, OneDrive and share runs were not run here.

obligations.how: Get-ProofRecordPath and Get-W001RootShape send a drive letter to docs/proof-runs/w001-<letter>-drive.json and everything else to artifacts. The new script tests/window/SL-003-W001OnASubstDrive.Tests.ps1 runs W-001 on a SUBST letter over a temp tree with two refused folders and checks the record's path and counts-only content. I ran it and it held (exit 0). The five scripts that read the engine's slice folder are deleted (W001ProofTests.TheScriptsThatReadTheEnginesSliceRecordsAreRetired).

Get-CoverageRecord copies report.coverage with strings dropped, summarizes folders as two counts, and adds panelTop, textsHeight and textsOffset. W001ProofTests.ACoverageRecordHoldsNoStringAndIsWritten feeds a coverage with remainder.text and checks the record is written. The SUBST run's record carried unseen, remainder and measured.

New pure Get-WholeDriveReportGaps, used by Test-W001 on a local letter, names each of: outcome not completed, coverage null, panel not on screen. W001ProofTests.AWholeDriveReportMustBeCompletedAndShowItsCoveragePanel feeds coverage null, a hidden panel, outcome cancelled and all three missing. The real run found and fixed a bug in this helper.

W001ProofTests.RootsAreClassedAndKeptWhereTheirShapeSays feeds C:\, C:, y:, a stubbed network letter, UNC share roots and folders, and W-002/W-003 variants. Variants must match ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$, so no root text becomes a file name.

Invoke-W001StoppedRun (half the finished folder count, FSA_HOOK_ROWS=1, up to 3 attempts with n halved) was run by tests/window/SL-003-W001OnASubstDrive.Tests.ps1 on a 30,302-folder tree: the stop landed at 17,302 folders with sized '-', and the subset relation held.

W001ProofTests.AStoppedRowIsPutInOneOfTheSixClasses feeds a 995 row, a code-5 row absent, one created after, one created before and changed after, a row with times unreadable, a non-5 row absent, a non-5 code change and a kind change, and a case-different path. TheActedLineIsReadInBothFormsAndPartialMeansStoppedWhileListing covers a Completed run and a sizing-pass stop.

New Get-ReasonCodeMismatches counts a row whose reason ends '(Windows error N)' with another N, and a row whose reason differs from the first row with its code. It is checked on a local letter and recorded elsewhere. Test: W001ProofTests.AReasonThatDoesNotBelongToItsCodeIsCounted.

Get-OracleRow classes a code-5 row whose plain open now fails with a code other than 0, 2, 3 or 5 as refused-another-code. Corpus row F17 (folder held without read sharing) is covered by W001OracleTests.TheOracleGivesEveryRowOfTheCorpusItsClass, which passed.

Test-W002 rig mode and tests/window/SL-003-W002OnTheCloudRig.Tests.ps1 are built (CfProvider 'tree' root, Seam.ListFiles listing, provider FETCH_DATA count, teardown checks, counts-only record). NOT RUN here: it registers a real cldflt sync root, which this project treats as opt-in and a person's or validate's. The pure parts are tested in W001ProofTests.AScanIsJudgedAgainstTheOnlineOnlyFilesBeforeAndAfter. Real mode (-Root) ran on a plain folder and ended inconclusive, as it should with nothing online-only.

Get-HydrationTally, Get-HydrationVerdict and Get-DataFetches are covered by W001ProofTests.AScanIsJudgedAgainstTheOnlineOnlyFilesBeforeAndAfter: a file that lost the attribute, a file gone, no online-only file, FETCH_DATA from the app pid against other pids, and every verdict order.

Test-W003Rig (one N-005-style stopped run, stopToEndingMs from the hook clock, cut folders by CheckSeamMain's rule, finally-written record) and tests/window/SL-003-W003OnTheStallRig.Tests.ps1 are built. NOT RUN here: the rig maps an SMB loopback share, which the project's constraints treat as person-run. The timing and cut-folder helpers are tested in W001ProofTests.TheStopToEndingTimeAndTheCutFoldersAreRead.

Get-StopToEndingMs returns null (never 0 or a negative) for a missing acted line, a missing 'rows read' line, a reversed time or a duplicate. Get-CutFolderRows and Get-ShareVerdict are covered by the same test and by W001ProofTests.AShareRunsVerdictPutsAMissedMarkerDeadlineFirst.

tests/bugs/SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1 now finds the rule by its new name and reads the engine-appended entry's plain (unquoted) scalars as well as quoted ones. It passes: corpus, writer agreement, and every docs/proof-runs/*.json. Plain scalars were found by reading the engine-appended entry.

Compare-StoppedRows classes a code-5 absent row as newSinceFinished when its creation, last-write or change time is after the finished run began. Times come from a FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES-only open (Seam.Times, ChangeTime included), falling back to the parent listing. A row whose times cannot be read, a non-5 absent row and a non-5 code difference are otherCodeDiffers and the verdict is inconclusive. Only 995, code-5 absent for a pre-existing folder, and code-5 kind change fail. Verified that Times reads a denied folder.

refused-another-code is counted with the leaks via Get-LeakCount into Get-W001Verdict's leak argument, so the verdict is failed whenever it is above 0. Before returning the class the oracle reads the folder's times through the attribute-only open and returns changed-since-scan when it was created or changed after the scan began. Corpus rows F17 and F18 cover both.

Callers now pass the writer only what it accepts: Get-RecordByCode nulls a reason holding a slash or backslash, Get-CountsOnly drops strings, Get-RecordString turns '' or missing into null, and the writer's labels are extended. Save-ProofRecord reports a writer refusal as a writer bug beside the run's outcome. Corpus: 25 rows. Against HEAD's old writer, 18 reason, text and label rows (R01-R03, T01-T03, L03, L05-L15) were refused; W001ProofTests.EveryStringACaseWouldPutInARecordIsWritten shows every row written the new way.

Invoke-W001StoppedRun writes the stopped part in a finally through New-StoppedPart (status and outcome null with no report, verdict 'failed' on a throw or timeout). The finished part is written first. Save-ProofRecord reports a writer throw next to the run's outcome. A drive-letter run without -Stopped or -Force refuses before scanning to overwrite a stopped part (verified on a copy of the record: exited 1 in 3 s with no scan). Test: W001ProofTests.ARecordFromARunWithNoReportIsWritten. My wrapper scripts remove the docs/proof-runs files they create; any planted E003 scripts must do the same.

Read-ActedLine parses ' folders=(\d+) ', ' sized=(\S+) ' and the time from the line's end (utc= or sincearmed=). Test-StoppedPartial requires Cancelled with sized '-', and the case retries with n halved up to 3 times, then ends inconclusive. Test: W001ProofTests.TheActedLineIsReadInBothFormsAndPartialMeansStoppedWhileListing, with the spike's exact line.

E003-1 is stated as Q-010 decided it: Get-ProofRecordPath writes only to docs/proof-runs or artifacts; the git grep half is a Fact and the fitness rule; the git status half is in tests/window/SL-003-W001OnASubstDrive.Tests.ps1 (passed). The engine-planted E003-1 script is not in this tree, so its old `-not (Test-Path .taad\slices)` line was not edited here; it remains the engine's to rewrite when it plants the script (see follow_ups).

Built as in O-014: Test-W003Rig counts every row for s, t or u (whatever the time) plus every 995 row and keeps CheckPanelAgrees' expected count of 2. tests/window/SL-003-W003OnTheStallRig.Tests.ps1 is the runner. NOT RUN here; see O-014.

The plant rows S91-S94 (UNC, single-backslash, forward-slash path, a 'path' key) and P41 (a whole valid record) are planted at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json. Get-HydrationVerdict: no report or non-zero exit is failed; status not Completed is inconclusive; hydrated or a data fetch is failed; nothing online-only before, unreadable folders, or (on the rig) goneSinceBefore is inconclusive. New-HydrationRecord writes null status, outcome and unreadable when there is no report. Tests: AScanIsJudgedAgainstTheOnlineOnlyFilesBeforeAndAfter and ARecordFromARunWithNoReportIsWritten.

W-003 rig counts a row for s, t or u whatever its time, plus any 995 row, and keeps CheckPanelAgrees' expected count of 2 (CheckSeamRow for a and b). Get-CutFolderRows tested with s, t, u, u with trailing backslash, 995 and a case-different leaf.

The record's rootShape key carries Get-W001RootShape's output, and 'unc' (with local-letter, network-letter, rig and the rest) is in the writer's allowed set. The corpus's shape rows run Get-W001RootShape through a stubbed $driveTypeOf, so all four shapes are reached on any machine. Against the old writer the new labels are refused (rows L05-L07 and the others).
Nothing was built or asked for: no re-tier was requested in this build. The slice keeps the minimal defaults.

Real run through the entry point, with the published exe and hook: a SUBST drive over a temp tree of 30,302 folders with two refused ones, non-elevated. deviations: Coverage's 'folders' array is written as two counts (unreadable, notScanned), not as the walk's copy of it. Its only data is each folder's kind, a word, so a walk that drops strings would leave hundreds of empty entries for a whole C:\. 'measured' keeps only bytes under the same walk. The design says the walk copies the figures; the rest is that walk.

-Case All is filtered inline in the existing `$cases = if ($Case -eq 'All') { ... | Where-Object { $_ -notin $ProofCases } }` statement, not through a new function. WindowCasesHelperTests.AllLeavesOutTheTimingCases reads that statement, and a first attempt with a Get-CaseList function broke it. The new test evaluates the script's own statement.

I added three finish-line scripts the design does not list (tests/window/SL-003-W001OnASubstDrive.Tests.ps1, SL-003-W002OnTheCloudRig.Tests.ps1, SL-003-W003OnTheStallRig.Tests.ps1), so that the case obligations have a command that feeds the real shape. The design's E003-1 to E003-5 scripts are engine-planted and not in the tree. If the engine plants them, the old E003-1 line `-not (Test-Path .taad\slices)` still cannot pass on uat (Q-010); it is the engine's to rewrite.

I added small pure helpers beyond the design's list so each rule can be tested: Get-LeakCount, Get-WholeDriveReportGaps, Save-ProofRecord, Test-KeptStoppedPart, New-StoppedPart, New-HydrationRecord, New-ShareRecord, Get-CutFolderRows, Get-ShareVerdict, Get-RoundedOrNull. Get-W001Verdict's signature is unchanged. The refused-another-code count goes through Get-LeakCount.

The guard runner SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1 reads plain (unquoted) YAML scalars as well as single-quoted ones, because the engine-appended entry's patterns are unquoted. I did not change the appended entry.
The reason-belongs-to-code check is required on a local letter only and recorded elsewhere, as the design says. The refused-another-code check applies to every root.

MISTAKE, disclosed: when deleting the retired scripts I ran `git rm -q --cached --ignore-unmatch` on one of them and then `git reset -q` (a mixed reset, no arguments). That moved nothing in HEAD or the working tree and left the index equal to HEAD, so anything that had been staged before, if anything was, is now unstaged. I made no commit, branch, checkout or stash.
docs/design/SL-107-c-drive-run.md still names the old record path. It is documentation, which a slice does not edit; the code is what is true.
No product code and no hook code was changed. No outside-defect workaround is involved, so no new setting or notice was added.
not_built: The maintainer's own runs: W-001 -Root C:\ -Stopped (finished and stopped whole-C:\ record, criteria C1b, C2, C3, C5), W-002 -Root on their OneDrive (C8), and W-003 -Root on a real share over home and Tailscale (C9). They are the person's (kernel pool held until a restart, their own account, physical cuts). No record exists under docs/proof-runs yet and none should be committed from this build.

W-002 on its CfProvider rig and W-003 on the loopback stall rig were built and are covered in their pure parts, but were not run here: they register a cldflt sync root and map an SMB loopback share, which this project gates to a person or validate. The real mode of W-003 (the prompts, the typed 'cut', the marker file) has never been run.
A hook change for the 60 s marker deadline was not built, as O-003 decided; a missed deadline ends W-003 real mode inconclusive with a record.
follow_ups: Validate should run tests/window/SL-003-W002OnTheCloudRig.Tests.ps1 and SL-003-W003OnTheStallRig.Tests.ps1 (or the planted E003-4 and E003-5) with a person's allowance, since they register a sync root and map a loopback share.

If the engine plants E003-1, its `-not (Test-Path .taad\slices)` line must be replaced by Q-010's two checks: `git grep -n -i taad -- tests/window/WindowCases.ps1` prints nothing, and `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- .taad` shows nothing new. Any planted E003 script must remove the docs/proof-runs files it creates.

After the maintainer's C:\ run, read the record for Q-001 (unseen against the measured $MFT, whose bytes are in measured[0]) and Q-002 (panelTop, textsHeight, textsOffset). Lesson #872 stands: the C:\ shape is not validated until then.
If W-003 real mode ends inconclusive because of the hook's 60 s marker deadline, the record is the evidence for an additive FSA_HOOK_MARKER_DEADLINE_S (default 60) in a later slice.
Seam.Probe's second open duplicates Seam.Times; Probe could call Times. Left as is to keep the oracle's existing behaviour untouched.

architecture.why: Write-W001Record writes proof-run records to docs/proof-runs (Get-ProofRecordPath in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1), and the fitness rule 'a committed proof-run record carries counts, codes and reasons, never a path' covers docs/proof-runs/*.json; no block's globs match that folder.
The proof runs are cases in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 (C-010), W-002 uses tests/CfProvider and W-003 uses tests/window/StallRig and the hook's rows and stop modes (C-008).
